page_title: MAL 1-1 ATM | Mallorca v Atletico Madrid 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' The current number of shots on goal is 3:7.
90+3' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Mallorca.
90+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jan Virgili (Mallorca). Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.

90+1' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
90+1' Corner kick. Mallorca will have an opportunity.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mallorca are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
88' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
87' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Jan Oblak is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
85' 1 - 1 Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
84' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
82' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Manu Morlanes will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Jan Virgili (Mallorca) is replacing Mateu Morey Bauza.
79' 0 - 1 Goal! 0:1. The ball rebounds to Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

79' That was a nice football moment. Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Leo Roman guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
78' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Mallorca get a free kick.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) replaces Nicolas Gonzalez.
76' The referee blows for a cooling break.
72' He’s off! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets his marching orders from referee Francisco Maeso after the VAR review.
71' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid)! Let's see what he decides.
71' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
69' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Leo Roman, who makes a comfortable save.
68' Substitution. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) on for Pablo Barrios.
68' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marc Domenech (Mallorca) replacing Takuma Asano.
67' It will be a substitution. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Samu Costa walks off.
67' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul during an attacking move. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
65' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort. Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
62' That will be all from Giacomo Raspadori who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
62' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) replaces Giuliano Simeone.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Julian Alvarez cannot continue after picking up an injury.

62' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
60' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
59' Free kick. Atl. Madrid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
57' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Atl. Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

53' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. That was a nice football moment. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Leo Roman guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

52' Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
51' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
49' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
45+4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) heads on.
45+2' It's a free kick to Mallorca, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Atl. Madrid have a free kick. Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
43' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Atl. Madrid is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
41' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
40' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Leo Roman is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

39' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
38' A cross from Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
36' Problems for Jagoba Arrasate as Marash Kumbulla is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Pablo Torre (Mallorca) replaces him.
35' Marash Kumbulla (Mallorca) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
31' A cooling break is underway.
27' Ball possession – 35:65.
24' The game is interrupted now, Martin Valjent (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

23' A neat pass is well received by Martin Valjent (Mallorca), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
21' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. It's a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
21' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
18' Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Leo Roman leaps out to thwart his attempt.
13' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
12' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. That is a penalty kick for Atl. Madrid.
11' 37:63 – the ratio of ball possession.

7' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a pin-point pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper performs an amazing acrobatic dive to deny him. The strike bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
4' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Leo Roman (Mallorca). Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
2' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
2' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
